rejected.reason: Dropping the qualifier leaves an unanchored kind — no named thing and no named group. Several corpus examples ('високовольтні електричні підстанції', 'ботмережа (більше 1000 комп'ютерів)', 'DNS-сервери для зони gov.ua') already sit at the kind level, so there is nothing coarser to name; they are depth-1 mentions.

rejected.candidate: esits:* / registry:* (any subsystem of ЄСІТС, any state register)
rejected.reason: Anchored, but no reference table computes membership from a name — nothing tells code that 'Електронний суд' belongs to ЄСІТС. That coarsening is already the g1 part-of rung to the named system; emitting a synthetic star node as well would duplicate it.

rejected.candidate: Державна судова адміністрація / НАЗК / оператор мережі (the body that runs or owns the system)
rejected.reason: Organization / Government Body, not Infrastructure. The operator is a different referent, never a wider name for the system. Belongs on the assertional layer as operated-by / owned-by.

rejected.candidate: зона gov.ua (as parent of 'DNS-сервери для зони gov.ua')
rejected.reason: Domain, not Infrastructure — the DNS zone is a naming object, the servers are the asset. Belongs on the assertional layer as serves-zone.

rejected.candidate: об'єкт критичної інфраструктури / критична інфраструктура
rejected.reason: A jurisdiction-relative legal designation applied to assets, not itself a named asset containing them. Belongs on the assertional layer as designated-critical-in.

rejected.candidate: енергетика / судова система (sector of the asset)
rejected.reason: Industry Sector, not Infrastructure. A substation is not a kind of sector; the link belongs on the assertional layer as serves-sector.

rejected.candidate: «анонімна мережа» above TOR, or 'ботмережа' above 'ботмережа (більше 1000 комп'ютерів)'
rejected.reason: Both coarsenings land on a bare kind with no named anchor; 'Tor network' vs 'TOR' is an alias, not a rung.

ladder.notes: Mixed category: mentions split into (i) named state systems and their named subsystems, where a real part-of rung exists (Електронний суд -> ЄСІТС), and (ii) generic asset kinds ('високовольтні електричні підстанції', 'ботмережа (більше 1000 комп'ютерів)', 'DNS-сервери для зони gov.ua'), which are depth 1 — their only coarsening is an unanchored kind, so no rung is emitted. Depth is therefore 2 at best and the single rung is widening (preserving: false), which forbids any blurring rung above it; no reference table (no Ukrainian register of state information systems is wired) binds this rung, so it stays defeasible. Default lambda for this category should be g0.

relationTypes.name: vendor_of
relationTypes.definition: The organization develops, maintains, or distributes the software product that was targeted or affected in the incident.

relationTypes.name: targets
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side software (malware, exploit kit, or offensive tool) is directed against, exploits, or compromises the target software.

relationTypes.name: manufacturer_of
relationTypes.definition: The organization manufactures, distributes, or maintains the hardware device that was targeted or affected in the incident.

relationTypes.name: communicates_with
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side software contacts, resolves, or beacons to the attacker-controlled domain as command-and-control or delivery infrastructure.

relationTypes.name: based_in
relationTypes.definition: The organization or government body is headquartered in, operates under, or is an official agency of the country.

relationTypes.name: belongs_to_sector
relationTypes.definition: The organization operates within, and is classified as part of, the named industry sector.

relationTypes.name: attributed_to
relationTypes.definition: The hacker group is assessed to operate from, be sponsored by, or act on behalf of the named country.

relationTypes.name: targets_country
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side software is deployed against, or its victims are located in, the named country.

relationTypes.name: targets_device
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side software (malware, exploit, or offensive tool) is directed against, exploits, or compromises the targeted hardware device.

relationTypes.name: located_in
relationTypes.definition: The targeted infrastructure or asset is physically situated in, or operated within, the named country.

relationTypes.name: targets_sector
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side entity directs its operations against organizations classified in the named industry sector.

relationTypes.name: targets_domain
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side entity attacks, compromises, or hijacks the targeted domain or the site it hosts.

relationTypes.name: targets_organization
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side software (malware, exploit, or offensive tool) is directed against, compromises, or infects the named victim organization.

relationTypes.name: uses_tool
relationTypes.definition: The hacker group deploys, develops, or is known to operate the named attacker-side software (malware, exploit, or offensive tool).

relationTypes.name: controls_infrastructure
relationTypes.definition: The hacker group registers, owns, or operates the attacker-controlled domain used for command-and-control, phishing, or delivery.

relationTypes.name: targets_infrastructure
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side entity attacks, disrupts, or compromises the named targeted infrastructure or asset.

relationTypes.name: operated_by
relationTypes.definition: The targeted infrastructure or asset is owned, operated, or maintained by the named victim organization.

relationTypes.name: used_against
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-controlled domain is used as phishing, delivery, or command-and-control infrastructure in operations directed at the named victim organization or government body.

relationTypes.name: targets_government_body
relationTypes.definition: The hacker group attacks, compromises, or conducts intrusion operations against the named government body or agency.

relationTypes.name: targeted_by
relationTypes.definition: The victim organization is attacked, compromised, or targeted by the named attacker-side actor (state agency, government body, or country).

relationTypes.name: sponsored_by
relationTypes.definition: The hacker group operates on behalf of, is directed by, or is sponsored by the named government body or state agency.

relationTypes.name: uses_device
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side actor operates, deploys, or repurposes the named hardware device as part of its offensive infrastructure or tooling.

relationTypes.name: hosts_domain
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-controlled infrastructure (server, host, or network asset) hosts, serves, or is the resolution target of the attacker-controlled domain.

relationTypes.name: uses_software
relationTypes.definition: The government body or agency deploys, operates, or relies on the named software product within its environment.

relationTypes.name: targets_software
relationTypes.definition: The attacker-side government body or state agency attacks, exploits, or compromises the named target software product.
